findings.title: Manual network-check logs RPC completion as healthy success
findings.evidence: Original Controller.invoke fixture returned business ok:false / issue:dns but emitted info network-check ok:true without issue; guard business ok is correct but reason is discarded.
findings.suggestedFix: Use network-check result.ok for manual info/warn and persist validated issue only; retain watchdog issue through _operation and Controller.onLog. Never log raw addresses or config.
findings.suggestedRegression: Original Controller.invoke plus production platform envelope: healthy, dns/http/stale-proxy business failure, and RPC error remain distinct. Guard check business failure logs ok:false plus reason. Verify export and feedback preview contain reason but no private network fields.

findings.title: Fresh-user system security and actual authorization dialogs are not established
findings.evidence: Mac CI explicitly installs helper with sudo bootstrap; local helper absent. Public page warns unsigned packages may require confirmation but has no verified end-user walkthrough.
findings.requiredEvidence: Downloaded quarantined Mac app opening on supported OS, actual install-helper consent including cancellation, and Windows first-run security/UAC path in disposable clean desktop. Do not treat sudo or package signatures as dialog acceptance.

findings.title: Navigation/release status still says center and page delivery pending while roadmap says delivered
findings.suggestedFix: Reconcile current status and explicit acceptance boundaries without promoting untested local authorization.

findings.title: Mac health depends on one HTTPS origin
findings.evidence: DNS/system/direct probes use the same public site; direct raw endpoint is supplementary. One site or regional filtering can report http while other sites work.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider independent HTTPS origins and state which checks failed; current diagnostics do not promise all-site connectivity.
